# 🚀 Pull Request Template

> Thank you for contributing! Make sure to review each section before submitting your PR. 🌟

---

## 📋 Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Highlight the purpose of this PR and any relevant context.

🔧 **Type of change:**

- [ ] Feature ✨
- [ ] Bugfix 🐞
- [ ] Refactor ♻️
- [ ] Documentation 📝
- [ ] Styles 💅
- [ ] Other (specify below)

---

## 📸 Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots or GIFs to showcase the changes.

---

## 🛠️ Commands to Test

| Command        | Action                                      |
| :------------- | :------------------------------------------ |
| `npm install`  | Installs dependencies                       |
| `npm run dev`  | Starts local dev server at `localhost:4321` |
| `npm run test` | Tests the application                       |

---

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.

---

## 🌟 Additional Notes

Feel free to add any additional context or notes here or references, docs, etc.

---

✨ Thank you for your contribution, astronaut! 🧑‍🚀
